name: BL4 Physics
description: Quake 3 pmove (q3.pm.*) over bl4x-baked collision meshes, with GTA V's walking tune.
rationale: bl4x's walker already writes metres, and the q3.pm.* constants are metres, so the chain runs unchanged. The traces sweep whichever archetype's btBvhTriangleMeshShape the player is over (bl4_collision_shape.cpp), not brushes or a heightfield -- there is no ground_guard step here, the same way packages/gta5 has none: trimesh collision has no cheap analytic height query to guard against.

steps.comment: Borrowed from gta5: Y toggles free flight, W held ramps up to 250 m/s -- useful for finding the baked region before walking it.

Pins the player at the spawn point until the tiles around it are resident, so nobody falls through a world that has not arrived yet (borrowed from gta5.player.hold). bl4.loading.text shows the percentage while it waits.

Borderlands-style fall recovery: more than 60 m below the last walkable ground (or below y=-1000) puts the player back on it. The city's central pit is bottomless by design, and bl4x cannot fill every hole in the ground.
Scripted flyover camera, off unless BL4_ORBIT_RADIUS is set: circles the map looking at its centre. The default centre is the middle of the baked map's extent (x -3.9..3.9 km, z -4.1..3.4 km).
